title: Active recall
lead: Your cards come from what you learn in Think first, the people you log and anything you want to keep.
empty: No cards yet. Close a question in Think first or create one with something you want to remember.
newLead: Something real you want to keep: a work fact, a word, a date. Write it as a question.
frontHint: What you'll see when reviewing. A concrete question beats a topic.
backHint: In your own words. Short is better.
personEditHint: This card comes from a person. Edit it from People's names.
suspendHint: It won't be asked until you turn it back on.
created: Card created. We'll ask you soon.
deleteConfirm: The card and its review history will be deleted.
nothingDue: Nothing due right now. What you reviewed will come back at the right time.
